== Notes ==
{{see|Battery}}
* 2 energy regeneration for 4 seconds essentially gives each affected ally 2.67 [[energy]].
* Due to its very short [[duration]] and [[spam]]mability, this skill is exceptionally good for triggering [[Echo (skill type)|echoes]].

== Trivia ==
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [["The Power Is Yours!"/Skill history|skill history]] for details. 
* This shout is the catch-phrase of cartoon superhero [[w:Captain Planet|Captain Planet]].
** During an [[Game updates/20090401|April Fools' Day update]], this skill was further related to Captain Planet by mocking a change to its functionality to match that of the Planeteers variant.
